howToUpdate: Edit _tools/descriptions.json or re-run _tools/extract.mjs, then `node _tools/generate.mjs`. Never hand-edit the HTML.

screens.title: Account
screens.summary: Account page inside app chrome showing the signed-in organization and profile, with "Sign out" and "Sign in as someone else" buttons. Each asks for confirmation, then signs out and returns to /sign-in.
screens.purpose: Lets any signed-in user see their account and sign out or switch to another user.
screens.missing: No profile editing, password change, or settings links; the two buttons do the same thing (sign out, go to /sign-in).

screens.title: Admin & Finance
screens.summary: Owner/admin hub with an overview of cards and a sub-view switcher: lead inbox/qualify, assignment board, close-out queue, payments, price sheets, time-off/blackouts, planning, reports, employees. Buttons: Add Job, Plan, Add Blackout.
screens.purpose: Central admin and finance module root for owners and admins to triage leads, assign jobs, close out work, and manage payments, pricing and time off.
screens.missing: Source has a TODO(forward contract) near line 708: no per-actor CompensationPolicy repository/field, so close-out compensation is not fully wired. Screen is read-only for job stage.

screens.title: Job Create Screen
screens.summary: Admin form to create a new job: text fields for address, description and scheduled start, with "Cancel" and "Create job" buttons. Shows a sign-in empty state if there is no session.
screens.purpose: Lets an owner or admin manually enter a new job (address required) and save it through the job repository.
screens.missing: Unmounted: no route or inbound nav found. No customer, service or area pickers (left null). Navigation is only via onCreated/onCancel callbacks, so the parent must wire them.

screens.title: Reports Job Detail Screen
screens.summary: Read-only report view of one job: status, address, schedule, technician, source, window, commission total, timestamps, plus an Activity audit-log list (newest first). Only button is Back.
screens.purpose: Lets owners and admins inspect a single job's details, commission total and audit history from the reports module without any edit actions.
screens.missing: Not mounted (no route or sub-view); receives job via props with no inbound navigation found. No job actions or links to the tech or customer.

screens.title: Add Task
screens.summary: Modal "Add Task" form: fields Name, Price ($), Est. minutes, Category, Details, Materials, an Active toggle, with Cancel and Add Task buttons. Validates price/minutes and shows inline errors.
screens.purpose: Lets owner/admin create a new ServiceTask (price-sheet item) under a service from the admin-finance module.
screens.missing: Nothing notable; it is a caller-driven dialog with injected onCreate/onCreated and no routes of its own.

screens.title: Assignments
screens.summary: Admin board of qualified/scheduled jobs: unassigned pool plus tech columns. Pick a visit kind (Service/Prem), choose a tech via Select, tap Confirm; a WarningSheet shows warn-only warnings. Category filter chips; tap job opens it.
screens.purpose: Lets owners/admins assign qualified or scheduled jobs to active techs, with warn-only conflict warnings before confirming.

screens.title: Add Blackout
screens.summary: Admin sees an "Add Blackout" form: Technician select, Start Date and End Date pickers, multiline Reason field, then Save and Cancel buttons. Shows errors (e.g. job conflict) while keeping the form filled.
screens.purpose: Lets owners/admins block out a technician's dates so they cannot be scheduled, creating a time-off blackout.
screens.missing: Nothing notable; create-only (no edit/delete of existing blackouts). Navigation is by onSaved/onCancel callbacks, no routes. Tech preselect only via initialTechId from Calendar.

screens.title: Calendar
screens.summary: Admin calendar of jobs and time-off in Week or Month list view, with prev/next/Today header, a "Technicians" Select (All Techs) filter and an "Add Blackout" button. Tapping a job opens it, assigns it, or goes to Assignments.
screens.purpose: Lets admins see scheduled jobs and tech time-off together by week or month, filter by tech, and add blackout dates or assign unassigned jobs.
screens.missing: No notable gaps; unassigned job taps with no tech selected fall back to the Assignments board rather than assigning directly.

screens.title: Close-Outs
screens.summary: Admin sees a read-only "Close-Out Queue" of jobs grouped into Unassigned, In Progress, Completed, each card showing customer, last-worked tech and blocker reasons. Tapping a card fires onSelectJob. Empty states shown.
screens.purpose: Lets owners/admins see which jobs await close-out and what blocks each one.
screens.missing: Read-only: no close action (deferred to P3h.3b per source comment). Navigation depends on caller-supplied onSelectJob; the screen itself has no routes.

screens.title: Close-Out Review
screens.summary: Admin sees one job's close-out review: status, a blockers list, Contact button, photo grid with Add photo and Remove, a quality-notes field, and a primary Close out job button disabled while blockers remain.
screens.purpose: Lets an owner/admin capture photos and quality notes and close out a finished job once no blockers remain.
screens.missing: No internal navigation; all actions are callbacks (onContact, onAddPhoto, onRemovePhoto, onChangeNotes, onCloseOut) that the caller must wire. No persistence of its own.

screens.title: Employee Detail
screens.summary: Admin sees one employee's name header, Back/Edit/Deactivate (or Reactivate) buttons, a detail card of identity fields (masked SSN and license), a Skills chip card, and a Service Areas card.
screens.purpose: Read-heavy drilldown of a single roster employee so owners/admins can review details and trigger edit or deactivate/reactivate.
screens.missing: Prop-driven only; no own navigation or fetching. Deactivate/Reactivate have no local confirm or loading/error state; the caller must handle them.

screens.title: Add/Edit Employee
screens.summary: Form to add or edit an employee: personal fields, Vehicle Status and Tool Status selects, role, area and skill chips. Buttons: Save, Cancel, and Revoke pending invitation & resend for pending invites.
screens.purpose: Lets owners/admins create or edit employee records, set roles, areas and skills, and manage pending invitations.
screens.missing: Nothing notable; it is a sub-view that returns via onSaved/onCancel callbacks and has no direct route navigation.

screens.title: Pending Invitations
screens.summary: Admins see a list of pending employee invitations for their organization. Each row has a Revoke button that removes it on success or shows an inline error. Has loading, empty and error states.
screens.purpose: Lets owners and admins review and revoke outstanding employee invitations.
screens.missing: No resend or copy-link action, and no link to create an invitation. Only an optional onBack prop; no navigation is wired in the source.

screens.title: Employee Job Detail
screens.summary: Read-only "Job Details" screen titled with the job address. Shows a card listing Status, Address, Scheduled date, and Assigned Technician, with a single "Back" outline button.
screens.purpose: Lets owner/admin view a single job's status, address, schedule and technician from the Employee Roster, without any editing.
screens.missing: No job actions by design (no status change, reassignment, or edit). Only navigation is the onBack callback; no link to the technician profile or full job record.

screens.title: Employees
screens.summary: Owner/admin sees the organization's employee list titled "Employees" with loading/empty/error states. Buttons: "Add Employee" and "Pending Invitations"; tapping a row selects that employee.
screens.purpose: Lets owners/admins browse org employees and reach add-employee, invitations and employee detail.
screens.missing: Navigation is via callback props (onAddEmployee, onViewInvitations, onSelectEmployee); the screen routes nowhere itself. "Show Test Employees" is a controlled prop with no visible control.

screens.title: Job Estimate
screens.summary: Admin edits a job's estimate: line items list with inline edit (Cancel/Remove), add via Manual or From Price Sheet (rate/area pick, Select), totals, copy share link, and Print / Save as PDF. Back to Job button.
screens.purpose: Lets owners/admins build, price, share and print a job's estimate from line items, manually or from the price sheet.
screens.missing: Stage is inferred (estimate precedes scheduling); no direct nav except onBack; approveEstimate is imported, but its button was not checked.

screens.title: Jobs
screens.summary: Admin Finance Jobs list: summary counts (on file, qualified/scheduled, awaiting close-out), "Add Job" button, unassigned-first job rows opening job detail, each with a "Plan" button; top tabs and gear menu.
screens.purpose: Gives owners/admins an overview of the organization's jobs so they can open, plan, create, or close out jobs.
screens.missing: Nothing notable found; shows "No jobs" empty state when list is empty. Add Blackout lives on the calendar sub-view, not this list.

screens.title: New Lead
screens.summary: Owner/admin form titled New Lead: text fields for name, phone, email, service, preferred date (YYYY-MM-DD), time, address, project details; buttons Cancel and Create lead. Shows sign-in prompt if no session.
screens.purpose: Lets an admin manually enter a new lead into the intake pipeline via the lead repository.
screens.missing: No navigation of its own; relies on onCreated/onCancel callbacks. Source, payer and attach-timing hold defaults in state but have no visible pickers. Name is the only required field.

screens.title: Edit Lead
screens.summary: Edit Lead form: text fields (name, phone, email, service, preferred date/time, address, project details) plus Source, Payer and Attach-timing pickers. Buttons: Back, Save, Create job. Shows a readiness hint and errors.
screens.purpose: Lets owners/admins correct a lead's details and check readiness before saving or converting it into a job.
screens.missing: No direct router navigation; Back, saved and Create-job transitions are delegated to parent callbacks (onBack, onSaved, onCreateJob). Not a dead end if the parent wires them.

screens.title: Leads
screens.summary: Admin sees a "Leads" list of unconverted leads, newest first, including needs_info ones with badges. Taps a lead row to open it, or "New Lead" to create one. Has loading, error and empty states.
screens.purpose: Lets owners/admins triage incoming leads before they are converted into jobs.
screens.missing: Navigation is purely callback-driven (onSelectLead, onCreateLead); New Lead is disabled if the host does not pass onCreateLead. No filters or search. Nothing hardcoded in the screen.

screens.title: Overview
screens.summary: Admin & Finance landing: scrollable cards (Leads, Jobs, Assignments, Close-Outs, Price Sheets, Payments, Review, Time off, Calendar, Reports, Employees) with live counts; tap opens that sub-view. Gear menu: Logins, Settings, Profile.
screens.purpose: Gives owners/admins a one-tap dashboard hub with counts to jump into each admin/finance area of the org.

screens.title: Review
screens.summary: Read-only reconciliation list for owner/admin. A "Needs attention" section shows pending or failed payments. A "Manually confirmed" section groups manual_confirmed payments by the tech who confirmed them. It has no buttons or pickers.
screens.purpose: Lets admins spot payments that are stuck or failed and audit payments that techs confirmed manually, before closing out jobs.
screens.missing: Display-only. No tap-through to the job or payment, no retry or resolve action, and no filters. Source has no navigation calls. It only reads the payments table.

screens.title: Payments
screens.summary: Admin Payments tab: one scrollable page stacking the Payments list, Reimbursement Queue and Payout Batches sections; selecting a payout batch shows its detail with a back handler. Can auto-scroll to Payout Batches.
screens.purpose: Merges payments, reimbursements and payout batches into one admin-finance tab so finance staff avoid separate tab navigation.
screens.missing: Nothing notable; it has no router navigation of its own and delegates to child screens and host callbacks (onSelectPayoutBatch, onBackFromPayoutBatch). Child-screen controls not inspected.

screens.title: Payments
screens.summary: Read-only Payments screen for owner/admin: a "Needs attention" list of pending or failed payments and a "Manually confirmed" list grouped by the tech who confirmed. No buttons or pickers; has loading, error and empty states.
screens.purpose: Lets admins reconcile payments by surfacing pending/failed ones and reviewing manual confirmations by tech.
screens.missing: Dead-end: no navigation, no actions. Source says marking paid is a job action elsewhere; no link to the related job or to retry a failed payment.

screens.title: Payout Batch Detail
screens.summary: Read-only payout batch drilldown: shows the period, status, each employee's frozen line (hours, commission, bonus, reimbursement, total, frozen date), the batch total, and a "Records only" note. Only button: Back.
screens.purpose: Lets owners and admins inspect a frozen payout batch's per-employee lines and total after a row tap in the batch list.
screens.missing: No actions beyond Back: no export, no mark-paid, no per-line drilldown. Lines show raw userId rather than employee names. Not routed; reached only via parent AdminFinanceRoot.

screens.title: Payout Batches
screens.summary: Admin lists payout batch records with their frozen lines and amounts; tap a batch to select it, and use Approve or Mark Paid buttons per batch. Shows loading/error/empty states and a banner that no payout is executed here.
screens.purpose: Lets owners/admins review frozen payout batches and record approval and paid status, without the app executing any payout.
screens.missing: No router navigation; onSelectBatch is an optional prop callback with no detail screen wired in the source. Batches are only displayed, never created here (persist happens elsewhere).

screens.title: Reimbursements
screens.summary: Admin sees "Reimbursements" with a "Pending Review" list showing amount and description per row. Each row has Approve, Reject (opens inline reason input), and Confirm Reject buttons; per-row errors show inline.
screens.purpose: Lets owners/admins review pending expense reimbursements and approve or reject them, with a required reason for rejection.
screens.missing: No navigation out; no filters for non-pending statuses or history; no detail or receipt view. Reject uses an inline reason input rather than a modal.

screens.title: Planning
screens.summary: Admin picks a job from a list, then fills a planning form (model numbers, parts, measurements, instructions, notes), manages a task list (Select, Remove), adds photos, and taps Save or Back to job list.
screens.purpose: Capture pre-visit requirements and reference photos on a job so the assigned tech has everything needed before the visit.
screens.missing: Add Photo is a stub using a placeholder storagePath; no real camera or photo picker or upload. No job-creation action when there are no jobs.

screens.title: New Price Sheet
screens.summary: Admin form titled New Price Sheet: enter a numeric version number, then tap "Create price sheet" (shows "Creating..."), or "Cancel". Shows an error message on failure and a sign-in prompt if no session.
screens.purpose: Lets owners/admins create a new draft price sheet version for their organization via the price sheet repository.
screens.missing: Only a version field; no rates or task prices entered here. Navigation is delegated to onCreated/onCancel callbacks, so the screen itself has no direct nav targets.

screens.title: Price Sheet Editor
screens.summary: Admin edits one price sheet: help panel, Publish button for drafts, standard duration (Save Standard Duration), area price adjustments with +/- sign and Save, service tasks with Active toggle and + Add Task, and rates with Save Rate.
screens.purpose: Lets owners/admins configure and publish the organization's price sheet (duration, area adjustments, tasks, rates) that drives job estimates.
screens.missing: No router navigation; it only shows an Add Task dialog. Publish exposes an onPublished callback for the host to navigate. No standalone route (sub-view only).

screens.title: Price Sheets
screens.summary: Admins see the org's price sheets grouped Published, Draft, Archived, each row with its status and publish date. A "Create price sheet" button shows at the top and in the empty state. Tapping a row selects it.
screens.purpose: Lets owners and admins browse every price sheet for the organization by status and start a new one or open an existing one.
screens.missing: No navigation wired in this file: onSelectSheet and onCreateNew are optional callbacks, so row taps and Create do nothing unless the parent passes them. No inbound route; it is a sub-view.

screens.title: Qualify Lead
screens.summary: Staff see a lead's details (tap-to-call phone) and pick Source, Payer, Attach timing and optional Service Area via AxisPicker. Missing fields are listed. Qualify is disabled until ready; Cancel exits.
screens.purpose: Lets owner/admin confirm a lead's source, payer and attach-timing axes so the lead can be qualified into a job.
screens.missing: No direct navigation; it is props-in/callbacks-out (onSubmit/onCancel), so routing and the qualify flow live in the caller. Only a phone link opens externally.

screens.title: Reports
screens.summary: Read-only Reports screen for owner/admin: jobs grouped by status, slot hit-rate (Hit/Miss/Unknown, Hit Rate %), and commission totals (Known/Unknown). Rows drill into job lists; "< Back" button returns.
screens.purpose: Gives admins read-only reporting summaries over jobs and commissions with honest unknown counts, drillable to job lists.
screens.missing: Takes plain jobs/commissions props, no data repo. Job-row selection (onSelectJob) relies on a parent wiring ReportsJobDetailScreen. Drill rows have no navigation of their own.

screens.title: Time Off
screens.summary: Admin sees time-off requests: a pending queue and an Upcoming Blackouts list. An "Add Blackout" button opens the blackout editor; each row has a "Cancel" button. Pending requests are decided automatically.
screens.purpose: Lets owners/admins review technician time-off requests and manage approved blackouts, which feed scheduling.
screens.missing: No approve/deny actions: pending requests are decided by a database trigger. Add Blackout navigates via the onAddBlackout callback, which the host must wire to BlackoutEditorScreen.

screens.title: Calendar
screens.summary: Week/month calendar of jobs and time-off. Header has week/month mode, prev/next/Today. Toggles: Show Test Jobs, Jobs, Time Off. Tap a job in week view to open it; tap a month day to jump to that week.
screens.purpose: Lets owners, admins and techs see scheduled jobs and time off by week or month and open a job from the schedule.
screens.missing: Month view jobs cannot be opened directly (only day drill-down). Techs cannot see time-off events (RLS limit noted in source). No create/reschedule actions.

screens.title: Settings
screens.summary: Settings screen under Configuration showing an empty state reading "Settings are coming soon." plus the app version label at the bottom. No buttons or pickers.
screens.purpose: Placeholder for future app settings that currently only displays the app version.
screens.missing: Placeholder only: no actual settings, empty menuItems and optionsItems, no navigation or controls; "coming soon" text.

screens.title: Test Jobs
screens.summary: Test Jobs list showing each test job's address and status with a Delete button. Footer buttons: Spawn Test Jobs, Delete All, Run Job Simulator. Simulator report has Dismiss and Run Again.
screens.purpose: Config tool to create, list, and delete test jobs and run the job simulator dry run for QA.
screens.missing: No router navigation out of the screen; no link to job detail from rows. Empty state only says to spawn jobs.

screens.title: Field Tech
screens.summary: Field Tech module root with a state-driven switcher: Overview, Jobs (DayList), Time Off, Prems, Reviews; selecting a job opens FieldJobDetail. Menu has Logins, Settings, Profile. Alerts on invalid Start/Stop actions.
screens.purpose: Hosts the technician's home area and wires per-job actions (on-my-way, start, complete) through status transitions.
screens.missing: Nothing notable; reviews and prems sub-views exist in source though the row's navTargets omit them.

screens.title: Completion
screens.summary: Tech sees a completion checklist checkbox, "Capture after-photo" button with photo count, Quality notes field, time worked, and "Complete job" button (enabled once checklist, photo and notes are done).
screens.purpose: Lets the field tech finish a job by confirming the checklist, adding after-photos and quality notes, then transitioning it to completed.
screens.missing: Exported but not mounted in any route. No navigation of its own; it only calls onDone after the job moves to completed. No visible link onward to QR payment/review.

screens.title: Jobs
screens.summary: Tech sees a Next Job card, a Week/Month calendar with Prev/Today/Next controls (jobs plus own time-off), and a Previous Jobs list. Tapping a day opens a Modal with that day's jobs and a Close button; address/phone tap copies.
screens.purpose: Shows the signed-in tech's assigned jobs by day and recent completed jobs so they can pick a job to open.
screens.missing: No direct routing; navigation is only via optional callbacks (onSelectJob, onOpenJob, onOpenTimeOff) supplied by the parent. Rows are inert if the parent omits them.

screens.title: Earnings
screens.summary: Per-job earnings breakdown: pay period, derived hours, bonus, commissions, reimbursements, close-out state. A text field plus a dispute button files a note-only dispute without changing job status.
screens.purpose: Lets a tech see what a job earned them (hours, bonus, commissions, reimbursements) and raise a note-only dispute.
screens.missing: Exported but unmounted: no route or inbound navigation. Takes job, period, bonusRule, etc. as props with no loader. No outbound navigation; dispute is the only action.

screens.title: Job Detail
screens.summary: Read-only job detail for a tech: header (job id, status, address), description, requested vs scheduled timing, a Call phone button, a tap-to-map address button, and admin notes list. No financial fields.
screens.purpose: Gives field techs a self-contained, finance-free view of one job's timing, contact, location and admin notes.
screens.missing: No status-change actions (accept, en route, start, complete), no checklist or payment links, no navigation out; no route of its own (jobId passed as prop). Display only.

screens.title: Greeting
screens.summary: Tech sees a newly assigned job with Accept and Decline buttons. Accept just dismisses. Decline opens a reason text field with Back and submit buttons; the reason is saved as a job note, then the job moves to declined.
screens.purpose: Lets a tech acknowledge a newly assigned job or decline it with a required reason.
screens.missing: Exported but unmounted: no route or caller. Accept does not transition the job (passive by design, status stays assigned). Navigation is only via the onDone callback.

screens.title: Overview
screens.summary: Read-only tech dashboard of count cards (Jobs, Time off, Reimbursements, Notes, Photos, Checklist). Tapping a count drills into a job list ('‹ Back to overview'); job rows open the job; time-off counts open Time Off.
screens.purpose: Give a field tech a quick at-a-glance summary of their assigned jobs, time off, reimbursements, notes, photos and checklists.
screens.missing: Reimbursement and time-off cards have no direct link to their own screens beyond callbacks; navigation relies on optional onOpenJob/onOpenTimeOff props, which do nothing if the parent omits them.

screens.title: Prems
screens.summary: Prems list of jobs needing a Prem. Each card shows customer, address, service, "Needs Prem since" date. Button reads "Claim" (confirm Cancel/Yes) or "Record" if claimed by me, opening the job's Prem report panel. Pull to refresh.
screens.purpose: Lets techs see the queue of jobs flagged as needing a Prem, claim one, and jump to record its Prem report.
screens.missing: No notable gaps; shows "Prem queue not available yet" when the port reports unavailable. No back/detail nav beyond the Record button.

screens.title: Reimbursements
screens.summary: Tech fills a form (Amount in cents, optional Description, optional Job ID) and taps "Submit request"; below, a read-only "My requests" list shows amount, description, status and date.
screens.purpose: Lets field techs request expense reimbursement and track the status of their own prior requests.
screens.missing: Not mounted (no route or sub-view). Receipt photo capture deferred. Amount entered in raw cents. Job ID is free text, not a job picker. No approve/deny here (admin-side elsewhere).

screens.title: Reviews
screens.summary: Placeholder empty-state screen titled "Reviews" showing the message "Reviews are coming soon." No buttons or pickers; reached from the field-tech H menu.
screens.purpose: Stub destination so the field-tech AppChrome H menu Reviews item resolves to a real screen instead of a dead onPress.
screens.missing: Whole feature is unbuilt: a "coming soon" stub with no review data, no controls, and no navigation out (source comment: no Reviews feature exists yet in field-tech).

screens.title: Start Checklist
screens.summary: Tech taps "On my way" (en_route), then "Start" to load the start checklist, checks items, captures before-photos ("Capture before-photo"), and submits to move the job to in_progress.
screens.purpose: Lets a field tech go en route, run the start checklist with before-photos, and submit it to start the job.
screens.missing: Exported but unmounted: no route or inbound navigation. It has no outbound navigation after submit; it only transitions job status.

screens.title: Time Off
screens.summary: Tech sees upcoming assigned jobs, a week/month calendar of time-off, and their requests list. A modal holds a date-range calendar and reason; buttons Submit, Save, Delete, Cancel, Close.
screens.purpose: Lets a field tech request, edit, and cancel time off, viewing it beside their upcoming assignments, outside the job state machine.

screens.summary: Root route "/" renders only RoleLandingRedirect; the user sees no UI of their own, and is sent to a role-specific landing screen. No buttons or pickers.
screens.purpose: Entry point that redirects each signed-in role (owner, admin, tech, sales) to its landing screen.
screens.missing: Redirect destinations live in RoleLandingRedirect, which was not read, so they are not listed. The screen itself has no UI.

screens.title: New Job
screens.notes: not declared in root Stack; picked up from file
screens.summary: Unified job screen with header and region tabs Plan, Prelim (Prem), Estimate, Assign, Schedule; actions Contact, Arrive, Complete, Paid, Sign out, gear menu. New-job mode: "New Job" form with Cancel/Save. WarningSheet for reassign.
screens.purpose: Single drilldown screen to create, plan, estimate, assign, schedule, arrive at, complete and mark paid one job.
screens.missing: No StartChecklist or QR payment/review step visible here; Arrive and Complete are header actions only. Not declared in root Stack (picked up from file). Source not fully read.

screens.title: Assign
screens.summary: Admin-only Assign tab on the Job page: shows "Assign Technician" with eligible techs to pick, plus unassign; busy/error shown; "Reassign job?" WarningSheet (Cancel/confirm) when moving a Prem tech.
screens.purpose: Lets an admin assign, reassign or unassign the technician (and Prem investigator) for a job, advancing it toward assigned status.
screens.missing: Nothing notable; region renders only when isAdmin, so owner/tech roles listed in the row never see it. Row buttonLabels only lists Cancel.

screens.title: Estimate
screens.summary: Tech-facing estimate editor: read-only materials line items, add-only form (Add Line Item), derived completion schedule/payment outlay, Submit for review, Share Link (copies to clipboard). Back to Job when not embedded.
screens.purpose: Lets a tech build and submit a job estimate within RLS limits (insert-only lines, header submit) and share it, inline in Job Detail or standalone.
screens.missing: No edit/delete of line items (RLS-limited by design); no approve/reject (admin-only). Navigation only via onBack callback; no routes of its own.

screens.title: Prelim (Prem)
screens.summary: Tech fills a guided on-site investigation form: ingress, logistics, parking notes and a state assessment. Buttons: Back to Job, Save Draft, Submit (stamps submitted_at). Shows job header and submit time.
screens.purpose: Lets an assigned investigator record preliminary site findings on a job before work, as one evolving record per job until submitted.
screens.missing: No router navigation; only an onBack callback. Reached from the tech's job detail once an investigator assignment exists, and can be embedded there. No link onward after Submit.

screens.title: Plan
screens.summary: Plan tab inside Job Detail: embeds the PlanningScreen for the current job, seeded from the investigation, where planning details, photos and plan tasks are edited. A Cancel button and WarningSheet appear.
screens.purpose: Lets owner, admin and tech plan the work for a job (tasks, photos, planned minutes) before scheduling.
screens.missing: Flow stage inferred (planning precedes scheduling); PlanningScreen internals not read. No explicit link to the Schedule tab from here.

screens.title: Schedule
screens.summary: Admin panel on Job Detail to set a job's scheduled start and end date/time via native pickers ("Pick date" on Android), then Save, "Clear schedule" or "Cancel"; "Back to Job" when not embedded. Time dropdowns use Select.
screens.purpose: Lets an admin set or clear a job's scheduled start/end time from Job Detail, saving through JobRepository.updateDetails.

screens.title: Jobs
screens.summary: Jobs tab: shows a "Show Test Jobs" toggle and a "New job" button. A tech sees their one assigned job rendered by JobDetail; everyone else sees an empty "No job selected" placeholder.
screens.purpose: Host screen that loads the tech's assigned job and passes it to JobDetail, with an entry point to create a new job.
screens.missing: No job list: the empty state says it "lands in a later slice". Owners and admins never get a job. Techs get only the first assigned job (limit 1), with no day list or switching.

screens.title: Module Host
screens.summary: Invisible host: resolves /m/[moduleId] via enabled-modules registry and renders that module's screen (admin-finance, field-tech, sales-marketing). Shows loading or empty state if disabled/not permitted. No own buttons.
screens.purpose: Single static route that hosts any module's component, injecting session and ports and gating by org and role.

screens.title: Not Found
screens.summary: The user never sees a Not Found page. Any unmatched route immediately renders RoleLandingRedirect, which sends them to their role's landing screen. There are no buttons or pickers.
screens.purpose: Catch-all for unknown routes that redirects the user to their role-specific landing screen instead of showing an error.
screens.missing: No visible 404 message or manual navigation. Redirect target depends on RoleLandingRedirect, which was not read.

screens.title: Payment Review
screens.notes: no logo-switcher entry; reached via admin-finance Review
screens.summary: Read-only "Reconciliation" screen for owner/admin: a "Needs attention" list of pending/failed payments and a "Manually confirmed" list grouped by tech, each row showing Job id, amount and status/date. No buttons or pickers.
screens.purpose: Lets admins reconcile payments that are pending, failed, or manually confirmed so close-out of paid jobs can be checked.
screens.missing: Rows are not tappable; nothing links to the job or to Mark Paid (owned by admin-finance). No logo-switcher entry; reached only via admin-finance Review.

screens.title: Profile
screens.summary: Account screen: edit Name and Email and tap "Save details"; Role is read-only ("Only an admin can change roles"). Change password with New/Confirm fields, Show/Hide toggles, and "Update password"; success/error messages shown.
screens.purpose: Lets any signed-in user view and update their own name, email and password.
screens.missing: No navigation calls in source (no explicit back or sign-out button); no inbound nav verified from this file alone.

screens.title: Root Layout
screens.summary: Invisible root Stack plus AuthGate. Shows loading, error or no-profile overlays with "Sign out" and "Sign in as someone else" buttons. Redirects signed-out users to sign-in and sends signed-in users to their role landing.
screens.purpose: Wraps every screen in the app, enforces authentication and role-based landing, and handles the no-profile dead-end state.

screens.title: Sales & Marketing
screens.summary: Sales & Marketing module shell with an app menu switching between Overview, Review Library, Pitch Picker, Composer, Reporting and Callback tasks; gear menu offers Sign Out, Settings, Profile; module switcher included.
screens.purpose: Hosts the sales/marketing module's six sub-screens as state-driven tabs under a single route for owner, admin and sales roles.
screens.missing: No service or service-area picker exists; serviceId and serviceAreaId stay null so Composer gets no service context. No job-status tie-in.

screens.title: Sign In
screens.summary: Sign In form: Email and Password fields (with show/hide toggle), a "Sign in" button ("Signing in…" while busy), an inline "Sign-in failed" error, and a "Create an account" button.
screens.purpose: Authenticates users by email and password so they can enter the app; on success the session listener swaps the route.
screens.missing: No forgot-password or reset link; the only navigation is to sign-up.

screens.title: Sign Up
screens.summary: Sign Up screen: notice that an admin invitation is required, Email and Password fields with Show/Hide toggle, a "Sign up" button (shows "Signing up…"), and a "Sign-up failed" error card on failure.
screens.purpose: Lets an invited user create their account with the exact email their admin invited, before entering the app.
screens.missing: No link back to sign-in and no forgot-password or email-confirmation handling. Navigation relies on the session listener swapping routes after success.

screens.title: Callback tasks
screens.summary: Sales sees a list of completed jobs awaiting a follow-up call, a "Show Test Jobs" toggle, and a "Mark Called Back" button per task that removes it from the list. Shows loading and error states.
screens.purpose: Gives sales a post-completion callback queue so customers of finished jobs get a follow-up call, tracked by a called-back timestamp.
screens.missing: No navigation out: no link to the job detail or customer contact/call action. Only write is Mark Called Back; no notes or outcome capture.

screens.title: Compose Post
screens.summary: User sees a suggested caption from the chosen pitch angle, picks a platform, edits the caption, toggles approved assets, taps "Approve draft", then manual export or direct post (if Meta enabled), then "Done".
screens.purpose: Lets sales/marketing staff assemble, approve, and export or post a social media draft from a pitch angle without auto-posting or fabricating claims.
screens.missing: No route of its own (sub-view only); Done just calls the onDone prop. Direct post is unavailable unless meta-publish is enabled, in which case the UI says so.

screens.title: Overview
screens.summary: Sales & Marketing landing view showing top open callback tasks, recent reviews with a "Recent reviews" link to the review library, and totals of posts by platform/period and reviews by platform.
screens.purpose: Gives owner/admin/sales users an at-a-glance dashboard of callbacks, reviews and marketing reporting totals.
screens.missing: No link to callback tasks or reporting; only the reviews link, and it depends on the optional onOpenReviewLibrary prop being supplied by the parent.

screens.title: Pitch Picker
screens.summary: Sales reps see a "Pitch Picker" title and four tappable cards (Service line, Community, Seasonal, Before / after), each with a description. Tapping one hands the angle to the Composer.
screens.purpose: Lets a sales rep choose the pitch angle for a marketing post before composing it.
screens.missing: No inbound route; navigation is via the onNavigateToComposer prop. The source says SalesMarketingRoot threads it "once it threads this prop through", so the wiring may be incomplete.

screens.title: Reporting
screens.summary: Read-only "Marketing Reporting" page: paid-ads out-of-scope notice, then counts of posts by platform and month, assets used, reviews by platform, jobs by source and by attach timing. No buttons or pickers.
screens.purpose: Gives owner, admin and sales users a non-financial overview of marketing activity and lead sources for the sales-marketing module.
screens.missing: Display only: no period picker, filters, drill-down or export. Reviews are not broken out by service or community because the ports lack those fields. No navigation out of the screen.

screens.title: Review Library
screens.summary: Sales sees published reviews with star rating, author, body, job id. Filters: Minimum rating chips (0-5), Service and Community id text boxes. Up/down arrows reorder rows; a curate button toggles curation.
screens.purpose: Lets sales browse, filter, reorder and curate already-published customer reviews for marketing use.
screens.missing: No outbound navigation. Filters are raw id text inputs, not pickers. Shows raw jobId since Review lacks service/community display fields; no link to the job.

screens.purpose: Lets a field tech pick a start/end date range for a time-off request using the same calendar look as the Jobs calendar.
screens.missing: Not a standalone screen; only used by TimeOff.tsx as a controlled component. No navigation of its own.

screens.title: Tabs
screens.summary: Bottom tab bar shell with two tabs, Calendar (with header) and Jobs (header hidden). Active tint is primary color; off-white scene background. No buttons or pickers of its own.
screens.purpose: Provides the tab navigation container that hosts the Calendar and Jobs screens for owner, admin and tech roles.
screens.missing: No role-based tab filtering or other tabs (settings, profile) declared; all three roles see the same two tabs.
